newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Siemens takes majority share in Nigeria affiliate.
newsitem.headline: Siemens takes majority share in Nigeria affiliate.

text.p: A Nigerian affiliate of Germany's Siemens A.G. said on Friday the worldwide engineering giant had re-acquired majority shares in it.
"It is welcome news that Siemens is bringing capital to this part of the world at this time," Peter Ogwuda, spokesman for Electro Technologies Nigeria Ltd. (ELTEC), said.
He did not say what percentage Siemens had now taken in the company in which Siemens used to have controlling shares before divesting several years ago.
Siemens had a 40 percent stake in the firm against 60 percent Nigerian holding before the latest re-acquisition.
The spokesman said ELTEC had now changed its name to Siemens Nigeria Ltd.
"We hope to derive technical and financial assistance from our parent company for our activities in Nigeria and West Africa," Ogwuda said.
Siemens is involved in electrical and electronic engineering projects in Nigeria.

These range from modernisation and expansion of the country's telecommunications network to the supply, installation and maintenance of office communication systems, power transmission and distribution equipment.
Industry sources said Siemens might be seeking to participate in Nigeria's telecommunications industry which is now being gradually liberalised.
